entities.summary: Ali Sharif Al Emadi is a Qatari economist and businessman. He served as the minister of finance from June 2013 to May 2021. He also served as chairman of the QNB Group and was on the board of directors of Ooredoo, Tunisian-Qatari Bank, and Union of Arab Banks.
